errors.text_span: Each pattern is represented by a series of bars corresponding to four groups (G₁, G₂, G₃, G₄), with the horizontal axis indicating the group index and the vertical axis representing the number of layers in each group.
errors.evidence: The figure does not have any labels on its axes, nor are the bars or x-axis positions labeled G₁, G₂, etc. The machine-generated description hallucinates these visual elements. This information is present in the paper's caption, but the description incorrectly presents it as being visible on the chart itself. The reference description correctly states that "no specific labels or units are present".
